DATED: 07/06/2  IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CRIMINAL MISC.APPLICATION NO. 16025 of 2021 ==========================================================
 NILESHBHAI BHAGVANBHAI DHUDA  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT ==========================================================
Appearance:
MR PM DAVE(263) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2,3,4 MR. SOAHAM JOSHI, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1 RULE SERVED for the Respondent(s) No. 2 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP N. BHATT  Date : 07/06/2023

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1.

The present application is filed by the applicants - original accused Nos.4 to 7 for seeking following prayers:-
"(A) YOUR LORDSHIPS be pleased to call for the records and proceedings of FIR being C.R. No. I- 11203030210618/2021 registered with Keshod Police Station, Junagadh and further be pleased to quash the impugned FIR and all proceedings in pursuance thereto, in the interest of justice;

(B) YOUR LORDSHIPS be pleased to stay the further proceedings in respect of and pursuant to the FIR being C.R. No. I-11203030210618/2021 registered with Keshod Police Station, Junagadh pending the admission, hearing and final disposal of this petition;
(C) YOUR LORDSHIPS be pleased to grant such other and R/CR.MA/16025/2021 ORDER DATED:
07/06/2023 further orders, as may be deemed fit and proper by this Hon'ble Court in the interest of justice;"
2. Heard learned advocate Mr. P.M. Dave for the applicants and learned Assistant Public Prosecutor Mr. Soaham Joshi for the respondent No.1 - State.

sentences.text: 3. Though served to respondent No.2 - complainant, no one has filed appearance on his behalf.

4. Brief fact of the case are as such that the applicant No.1 is elder brother of the accused No.1 and applicant No.2 is the wife of the accused No.1's elder brother, applicant No.3 is the sister of accused No.1 and applicant No.4 is the husband of accused No.1's sister, against whom the F.I.R. being C.R.
No.I-11203030210618 of 2021 is registered before Keshod Police Station, Junagadh on 9.7.2021 under the provisions of Section 498A, 323, 506(2) and 114 of the Indian Penal Code.
It is the case of the appellants in this application that the marriage of accused No.1 was solemnized with respondent No.2 on 15.5.2015 as per Hindu rites and rituals at Village Sondarda.
After marriage, respondent No.2 was staying with accused Nos.2 & 3 in joint family.
Out of that wedlock, a son named - Aarav was born.

Thereafter, on 19.3.2017, accused No.1 and respondent No.2 along with R/CR.MA/16025/2021 ORDER DATED: 07/06/2023 minor son - Aarav started living separately at Village Sondarda, which is parental living of the respondent No.2.

After a delay of four years of alleged incident, F.I.R. came to be lodged on 9.7.2021 as a counterblast against the divorce proceedings filed by the accused No.1 just to create pressure, by arranging all the family members.
Therefore, the present application is filed for quashing the impugned F.I.R. and all the proceedings.
5. Learned advocate Mr. P.M. Dave for the applicants has submitted that considering the F.I.R., the allegation in general nature is made against all the family members.

He has also submitted that the accused No.1 is husband, who is son of the applicant No.1 and husband of respondent No.2 were staying separately since the year 2017 with minor son along with respondent No.2.

He has further submitted that there is a delay in lodging of F.I.R. which is after four years of so-called incident,
with a view to pressurize the applicants, whose son has filed divorce petition against the respondent No.2.
He has further submitted that otherwise also considering the general allegations made in the F.I.R., no relevance, under Section 498A or under any other sections is attracted.

He has placed reliance upon the judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of State of Haryana versus Bhajan Lal and Others reported in AIR (1992) SC 604 and R/CR.MA/16025/2021 ORDER DATED:
07/06/2023 has submitted that the F.I.R. as well as other consequential proceedings is required to be quashed.

entities.text: State of Haryana versus Bhajan Lal and Others reported in AIR (1992) SC 604
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Per contra, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor Mr. Soaham Joshi for the respondent No.1 - State by opposing the prayers made in this application has submitted that on bare perusal of the entire F.I.R., it reveals that complainant has given specific complaint against the family members.

He has further submitted that after a span of six years between the original complainant with husband, they have stayed together with family members for some time, and therefore, prima facie the case is made out against the applicants and therefore, he has submitted that this Court should not exercise the powers under Section 482 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 by quashing and setting aside the impugned F.I.R. and all proceedings.
7.
I have heard rival submissions made at the bar by the respective parties made.
On perusal of F.I.R., it transpires that no specific allegation is made against the applicants and general allegations are made with a view to implicate all the family members of the husband.

It is also required to be taken into consideration that the F.I.R. is filed after a much delay on 9.7.2011 whereby admittedly,
as per F.I.R., the alleged incident was occurred on 17.3.2017 and thereafter, on Nileshbhai Bhagvanbhai Dhuda vs State Of Gujarat on 7 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84817912/
2 R/CR.MA/16025/2021 ORDER DATED: 07/06/2023 19.3.2017 and at the best, as per the F.I.R.,
last event was occurred in the month of October, 2017 and therefore, the F.I.R. was filed after almost four years of delay.

entities.text: Nileshbhai Bhagvanbhai Dhuda vs State Of Gujarat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
After considering the aforesaid and also after considering the averments made in the F.I.R., no believable case is made out, which attracts any of the Sections more particularly Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and if applicants will be compelled to face the trail pursuant to such F.I.R., it will amount to abuse of process of law and therefore, considering the ratio of judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Bhajan Lal and Others (supra), this Court is of the opinion that discretion under Section 482 of the Criminal Procedure Code is required to be exercised by quashing the impugned F.I.R.
8.
Accordingly, this application is allowed.
9. C.R. No. I- 11203030210618 of 2021 registered with Keshod Police Station, Junagadh is hereby quashed.
Consequential proceedings, if any, is also quashed.
Rule is made absolute.
Direct service is permitted.
(SANDEEP N. BHATT,J) DIWAKAR SHUKLA Nileshbhai Bhagvanbhai Dhuda vs State Of Gujarat on 7 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84817912/
